name: Autonomous AI crawler
description: An autonomous AI-powered web crawler for data collection and analysis.

inputs.system: You are an automated web crawler tasked with extracting social media URLs from a webpage provided by the user. You have access to a text retrieval tool to gather all text content from the page and a URL retrieval tool to identify and navigate through links on the page. Utilize the URLs retrieved to crawl additional pages. Your objective is to provide a unified JSON output containing the extracted data (links to all possible social media profiles from the website).

output.description: Every match: the "href" attribute of the element(s) matching the CSS selector a

inputs.system: Extract values from the HTML page the way the given CSS selectors would. Copy text exactly as it appears in the page. Use an empty string or an empty array when nothing matches.

template.categoryLabel: AI Research, RAG and Data Analysis
setup: Setup value supabaseProjectRef: Supabase project ref (Settings > General) (for example abcdefghijklmnopqrst). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: "Get companies": set the Supabase project ref (Management API) on SUPABASE_SELECT_ROWS.
"Crawl website" used agent tools in the original: Text (toolWorkflow), URLs (toolWorkflow). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
"Convert HTML to Markdown" (markdown.markdownToHtml): Markdown to HTML is a minimal converter on Yantra.
"Convert HTML to Markdown": Markdown to HTML is a minimal converter on Yantra; swap in a connector if you need full fidelity.
"Retrieve URLs" (html.extractHtmlContent): CSS selectors become a structured-output LLM extract; verify results on a real page.
"Retrieve URLs" extracted HTML with CSS selectors; on Yantra a structured-output step reads the page instead. Check the result on a real page, and trim very large pages before this step.
"Merge all data" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
"Insert new row": set the Supabase project ref (Management API) on SUPABASE_INSERT_ROW.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect supabase: `cdecli credential create -n "supabase" -p supabase --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
### Text scraper tool
This tool is designed to return all text from the given webpage.

💡 **Consider adding proxy for better crawling accuracy.**

### URL scraper tool
This tool is designed to return all links (URLs) from the given webpage.

💡 **Consider adding proxy for better crawling accuracy.**

### Get companies from database
Retrieve names and websites of companies from Supabase table to process crawling.

💡 **You can replace Supabase with other database of your choice.**

### Set parameters for execution
Pass only `name` and `website` values from database. 

⚠️ **If you use other field namings, update this node.**

### Crawling agent (retrieve social media profile links)
Crawl website to extract social media profile links and return them in unified JSON format.

💡 **You can change type of retrieved data by editing prompt and parser schema.**

### Insert data to database
Add new rows in database table with extracted data.

💡 **You can replace Supabase with other database of your choice.**

## Autonomous AI crawler
This workflow autonomously navigates through given websites and retrieves social media profile links. 

💡 **You can modify this workflow to retrieve other type of data (e.g. contact details or company profile summary).**
